acceptanceCriteria.text: #944 and #945 are valid governed Source Issues under this Epic.
Every implementation responsibility is represented by a child Implementation Issue with explicit scope, tests, branch and dependencies.
Provider-neutral worker/runtime and governed-execution contracts are implemented without Pi-native core types.
Pi adapter package launches/binds workers and consumes live Pi lifecycle/tool events.
A worker can report bounded semantic phase/activity/progress through the Mottainai contract.
Fleet/worker status can be repeatedly observed without adding input to or interrupting the worker session.
Explicit steer/stop control remains separate from observation and is auditable.
Governed execution admission binds accepted task authority to authoritative Nawabari evidence and a runtime worker without direct Pi↔Nawabari domain coupling.
Correctly admitted workers can obtain canonical branch/base/worktree/task/scope/verification facts without routine Git/history rediscovery.
The Pi adapter is independently buildable, testable, versioned and releasable from this repository.
Package smoke/certification installs/loads the produced Pi adapter artifact.
End-to-end certification proves one Mottainai-launched Pi worker can execute governed work while an orchestrator observes compact live progress without interrupting it.
Existing non-Pi Manager/runtime behavior remains compatible.
Full repository verification is green on the integrated Epic head before the Epic PR is considered ready.
